title: Job dream disguised as a mall dream
content: I had a mall dream last night that took me to many different venues, but it was really a dream about work. Last November, my position was eliminated. It was one of those situations where I was notified and then out the door in 10 minutes. I haven't spoken to my former boss since then, and I'm still working through a lot of grief and anger over the situation. Last night, my dream started at a summer camp. That tracks because I spent a lot of time at camps as a teenager, and I have many fond memories. While at the dream camp, I run into one of my former team members from this job I recently lost, someone that I'm fond of. The dream then cuts to the basement of a student union similar to one at a university where I worked for many years. Again, I have fond memories of this university. Then the scene cuts to a hospital. I dream about hospitals occasionally; I spent a decade in healthcare marketing and have mostly good memories of my healthcare days. I'm walking through the hospital, which morphs into a mall then into a conference hotel with meeting rooms. I walk into one of the conference rooms to meet with my former boss from this job I lost; the story was that she had hired a freelancer and wanted me to provide some background for her. For whatever reason, I agreed to this meeting, despite the fact that I was no longer working for her in the dream world either. After talking to the two for a few minutes, I am suddenly in another location within the hospital/mall/hotel. I'm back with my former boss and she's telling me she will need more information for me. Then she adds that it's a busy day and maybe we should talk another time. At that point, I become really annoyed and just tell her another day would be better for me, too. I then start coughing because of a cold, and I make a point of coughing on her because I'm upset and I'm hoping to expose her to whatever I have. Classy, I know, but definitely not something I would do in real life. Then I tell her that I will grab a business card and give it to the freelancer so she can contact me with questions. I guess I thought I could maybe avoid another meeting this way. She then tells me she knows of a job at XYZ Company (I can't remember the name), adding "But it's on my side" (in her state across the river from me). I leave this second conference room and try to find the original one where the freelancer had been. But I can't find the room and realize I'm at the opposite end of this very large facility from where I've parked. While I'm wondering if I should retrace my steps to the other end of the building to find my car, or if I should just leave via the nearest exit, I wake up. Normally my mall/hotel/university dreams don't seem to be so grounded in current things I'm wrestling with. Obviously I have a lot of feelings to process right now. I'm curious to know if other people have had similar loaded mall dreams.
